Seker Finansal Kiralama A.S. ( (TR:SEKFK) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Şeker Finansal Kiralama A.Ş. has launched a primary market offering of unused preemptive rights as part of a capital increase from TL 100 million to TL 200 million. Investors must apply through BIST equity market members, and activation of trading for the primary market series is contingent on timely submission of required documentation and remaining share information to the depository.

By partnering with Şeker Yatırım Menkul Değerler A.Ş. as intermediary, the firm underlines its integration with Turkey’s organized capital markets infrastructure.
